title: fix(plugin-auth): a correct-password sign-in refused by an organization IP list no longer counts toward the account lockout
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X2yt1mWbT9wcdVqxqkNbGab)_

Fixes #31251

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`auth-manager-after-hook.ts` 的 ADR-0069 D2 锁定计数器,遇到三种「密码已通过、之后才被拒」的登录时不再计数,也不清零:组织 IP 名单拒绝(`403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED`)、账号被封禁(`403 BANNED_USER`)、邮箱未验证(`403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`)。其余拒绝照旧计数,成功照旧清零。
- 为什么改:密码正确的本人会把自己锁住:在组织网络外登录三次,回到网络内被拒 `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`;封禁解除后仍被锁;等验证邮件期间登录三次,验证后仍被锁。
- 风险与回滚:只少计「密码已正确」的三种拒绝,错误密码在任何情况下仍然计数,所以不给猜密码者多留尝试次数;调用方看到的 403 状态、错误码、文字和审计行都不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-after-hook.ts`(`refusedAfterTheCredential`、`VENDOR_BANNED_USER_CODE` 与计数调用处),再看 `account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts` 末尾新增的两个 describe。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts`,预期 11 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-after-hook.ts`: in the `SIGN_IN_EMAIL_PATH` branch, a refused sign-in whose code `refusedAfterTheCredential` names skips `recordSignInOutcome`: no increment, no reset. The set, per the claim and its amendment, each code named by a constant: `SESSION_SCOPING_REFUSAL.code` (imported from `organization-access-policy.ts`); `BASE_ERROR_CODES.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.code` (`@better-auth/core/error`, loaded lazily as the before-hook does); and `VENDOR_BANNED_USER_CODE`, one module-level constant whose comment names its vendor source (`ADMIN_ERROR_CODES.BANNED_USER` in better-auth's admin plugin, which the package exports on no public path). `auditRefusedSignIn` still runs, so the refusal's `login_failed` row is written exactly as before (and as #31249 then shapes it). The status, code, message and timing the caller sees are untouched: the after-hook only ever observed the returned error.
- The predicate is an async function evaluated per sign-in, not a module-level `Set`: `organization-access-policy.ts` imports `auth-manager.ts`, which reaches the after-hook through `auth-manager-auth-instance.ts`, so on that import order a module-level constant built from `SESSION_SCOPING_REFUSAL` would read it before it is initialised.
- Why these codes can only arrive after the password passed: better-auth 1.7.12's `signInEmail` throws `INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` for a wrong password, then `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (when the deployment requires a verified address), then calls `createSession`, whose `session.create.before` hooks raise the organization list's `IP_NOT_ALLOWED` (`refuseUnadmittedScoping`) and the admin plugin's `BANNED_USER`. A wrong password never reaches any of the three. The deployment's own list (`allowed_ip_ranges` on the deployment) refuses at the auth-route middleware in `auth-plugin.ts`, before better-auth runs, so it never reached this counter.
- `.changeset/31251-org-ip-refusal-lockout-counter.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch (the after-hook ships in the package's `dist/`), naming all three refusals.

## Tests

New top-level `describe` in `src/account-lockout-resolved-account.test.ts` (the lockout's shared harness: real `AuthManager.handleRequest` over the in-memory engine; the file's `post` gains an optional `remoteAddress`). The account is a member of an organization whose own list admits only 10.1.0.0/16; deployment threshold 3.

1. Three correct-password sign-ins from 10.2.0.7 each answer `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED` (code + status) and leave `failed_login_count` at 0; no `account_locked` event; the next sign-in from 10.1.0.7 answers 200 and the count is 0.
2. Two wrong passwords from inside raise the count to 2; a correct password from outside (`403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED`) leaves it at 2 and the account unlocked: the refusal neither counts nor clears.
3. Controls: a wrong password from outside answers `401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD` and counts (the credential refuses first, the organization list is never reached); a wrong password from inside counts; a correct password from inside clears to 0; three wrong passwords from outside lock, and the correct password from inside is then `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED`.

A second new `describe` on the same harness (`deployment` takes config extras):

4. Ban (`plugins.admin: true`, the account's `banned` set): two wrong passwords count to 2 (`401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD`, the wrong-password control); three correct passwords each answer `403 BANNED_USER` (code + status) and leave the count at 2, no lock, no `account_locked` event; the ban lifted, the correct password answers 200 and clears to 0.
5. Unverified address (`emailAndPassword.requireEmailVerification`, `email_verified` false): two wrong passwords count to 2; three correct passwords each answer `403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` and leave it at 2, no lock; one more wrong password reaches the threshold and locks.

<details><summary>Red first</summary>

- Cases 1–3 on origin/main 0d0c377b (fix absent): 2 failed / 7 passed. Case 1: `attempt 1: expected 1 to be +0`; case 2: `expected 3 to be 2`. Case 3 (controls) green on main, as intended.
- Cases 4–5 against the first head's after-hook (`c38cc4cf`, skip set = IP list only; file restored to the tree only, then `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty): 2 failed / 9 passed, both `attempt 1: expected 3 to be 2`. On main the same two refusals count too (sweep below).
- The card's sequence, probed on main with the same harness (throwaway file, deleted): `[403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED count 1, 403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED count 2, 403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED count 3, then from inside 403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED count 3]`, matching the card.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, one leg per code</summary>

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` on `auth-manager-after-hook.ts` (blob e06b13de2fc4 at the fix commit), one list entry at a time; each leg restored to blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- `VENDOR_BANNED_USER_CODE,` deleted (→ 46ae4dc78472): case 4 red only, 1 failed / 10 passed.
- `BASE_ERROR_CODES.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED.code,` deleted (→ 92ed2737beda): case 5 red only, 1 failed / 10 passed.
- `SESSION_SCOPING_REFUSAL.code,` deleted (→ 117bb456302b): cases 1 and 2 red, 2 failed / 9 passed.

The first head's whole-skip ablation (c38cc4cf, the skip never firing) read cases 1 and 2 red. The test resolves the after-hook from `src/` through relative imports inside the package, so no `dist/` leg applies.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

Sweep of the other refusals that can reach this counter on `/sign-in/email` after the password passed (measured with throwaway probes on the same harness, deleted; better-auth 1.7.12):

- **Ban (`403 BANNED_USER`)**, with the admin plugin on (`plugins.admin`, or forced on by SCIM): thrown by the vendor admin plugin's `session.create.before`, the same path as the organization list. On main it counted: three correct-password sign-ins of a banned account locked it, and after the ban was lifted the next correct sign-in answered `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED`. **Fixed here** (claim amendment on #31251, cases 4).
- **Email not verified (`403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED`)**, with `emailAndPassword.requireEmailVerification`: thrown by `signInEmail` right after `password.verify` succeeded. On main it counted: count 2 → 3 and locked on one correct-password attempt. **Fixed here** (same amendment, case 5).
- **MFA hold** (`plugins.twoFactor` on, the account enrolled): the sign-in answers 200 `{ twoFactorRedirect: true }`; this hook runs before the two-factor plugin's after-hook and sees the session payload, so it **clears** the count (2 → 0). Not a refusal; the password passed and the second factor has its own lockout projection. Correct as is.
- **Concurrent-session cap**: `enforceConcurrentCap` runs on the success branch and ends the oldest sessions; it refuses no sign-in, so nothing reaches the counter (by reading).
- **Organization idle / absolute limits** are judged on session reads and on an organization switch, not at sign-in; an organization's MFA requirement is a hold recorded on the `login` row with a 200 answer (by reading). Neither reaches the counter as a refusal.
- **Deployment IP list**: refused at the auth-route middleware before better-auth, never reaching the counter (by reading). Unchanged.
- PR #31249 (in review) touches `auth-session-audit.ts` and `auth-manager-database-hooks.ts`; this PR only imports `refusalCodeOf` / `SIGN_IN_EMAIL_PATH` from the former and changes neither. The new pins assert no `login_failed` row content, so they hold whichever lands first.
- Published answers: the `403 IP_NOT_ALLOWED`, `403 BANNED_USER` and `403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` answers are unchanged (the after-hook only observes them); the only answer that moves is a later sign-in that main refused `403 ACCOUNT_LOCKED` and now admits, which is the defect. Hence `Clause-②: no`.

## Verification

All on head `f2bb01d5` (base `origin/main` 0d0c377b; `origin/main` has since moved, with no commit under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, so no merge was taken; PR #31249 had not landed when this was read).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test` under the verification lock: VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 237 passed (237), Tests 4209 passed / 10 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`) exit 0, after the package's own build.
- Scoped lint: `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched `.ts` files, exit 0.
- Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (62 families; the widened diff adds `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary`, exit 0), each run with stdin closed and its exit captured before any pipe, reconciled with `--ran`: "62 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED". 61 exit 0.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`**, reason: exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it loads every package's `dist/`; only the plugin-auth closure was built). CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it on a full build.
- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 0 after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876` (its pinned fixture, on this shallow clone).
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.
